summary: The booking-facing surfaces resolve branding correctly: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299-302 calls shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent, and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58 calls shouldHideBrandingForEvent, both of which route into packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:85-110 where resolveHideBranding (packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45) lets the organization's hideBranding override the entity's. The automation path does not. The cron sender packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, 274-276 and 433-435 computes `brandingDisabled` as `reminder.booking.eventType?.team ? !!reminder.booking.eventType?.team?.hideBranding : !!reminder.booking.user?.hideBranding`, reading raw columns and never consulting the parent organization; the data it reads is shaped that way by packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts:40, 166-171 and 197-203, whose select pulls team.parentId + team.hideBranding and user.hideBranding but never team.parent.hideBranding nor the owner's organization profile. The scheduling side repeats the same mistake by passing the organizer's personal flag: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618, 2793, 2808, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459 and 472, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230 and packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:561 all pass `hideBranding: !!…owner?.hideBranding` (team-owned events therefore fall back to a user flag that is usually null). apps/api/v2/src/modules/atoms/services/event-types-atom.service.ts:423 composes the same value for the platform booker as `eventType.team?.hideBranding || user?.hideBranding || null`, with no organization override. The flag is then threaded untouched through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56, 97, 161, 213, 248, 262-280, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38, 115, 147, 182-204, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18-82 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:148-156, 233, 244-256, 491, until the templates gate the vendor line on it: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/customTemplate.ts:216, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-83 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-80 emit `Scheduling by ${APP_NAME}` whenever the (wrongly resolved) flag is false. The correct pattern already exists inside the same feature: packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:11, 133-136 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:9, 90-93 call getHideBranding, which loads user profiles via packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1333 and team parents via packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-470.
